request: Thirty substantive promotion passes under the user's explicit strict modern typing and maintainability policy.
policy: Deterministic style and typing conventions may block when a useful manual remedy preserves existing contracts. No unsafe autofixes; exact reasoned exceptions remain available. Ambiguous behavior-changing rewrites retain warnings.

promotionPasses.evidence: Adjacent unguarded cases have identical bodies and bindings; use an OR pattern, preserving comments and useful boundaries.
The assignment followed by an explicit None guard has one evaluation; declared pre-3.8 projects are excluded.
The local regex result and truthiness guard can share one binding; declared legacy targets remain excluded.
The supported read/termination loop has one binding and preserved termination semantics; legacy targets are excluded.
Replace a bare unused marker with an informative retained name; preserve object/resource lifetime instead of deleting the assignment.
Owned ordinary classes and stable constructor origins prove a missing declared nominal relationship. Dynamic hooks, class escapes, aliases, opaque value escapes and reassignment abstain.
A closed canonical callable mock with known invocation syntax lacks argument checking. Escaped providers and altered or escaped specs abstain.
A named contract improves record typing. Explicit named open Mapping/dict aliases remain valid, preserving wire and extension behavior.

Consolidate supported adjacent handlers, closed native transformations or redundant record forwarders. Namespace/frame access, escaping references, provider mutation and independent extension contracts are excluded; manual edits preserve intentional seams.
Declare owned constant intent explicitly; Final[list[T]], Final[set[T]] and Final[dict[K,V]], including Annotated wrappers, preserve mutable APIs and identity.

Effective canonical before validators on owned plain Pydantic model ancestry must preserve raw inputs. Decorator replacement, provider/model escapes, nested lexical owners and class-creation/schema hooks abstain.

Only final instance methods on stable undecorated module classes without bases, with a closed canonical final provider and returns equal to the unrebound receiver, block. Other nominal/override promises stay advisory.
Only private undecorated synchronous module functions with known direct callers block broad Callable signatures. Public, escaped and asynchronous contracts remain advisory.
Only closed private synchronous functions with known calls block interchangeable positional roles. Public APIs remain advisory; nominal role types can preserve positional ABI.
Only start values used exclusively in direct duration-loop comparisons against finite nonnegative literal thresholds block. Returned or logged clock telemetry remains advisory.
Supported list/set builders and dict builders with stable local/literal keys block. Descriptor keys and visible namespace/frame access retain warnings to preserve evaluation order.

The typed owned abstract contract, implementation and rejecting instanceof consumer must be ordinary. All owned program modules are checked for class escapes; static blocks, constructors and prototype changes abstain.
Name the exact copied child schema type with typeof Child or a shared explicit alias. Preserve independently pinned public types and runtime schema identity.
Name supported complex return shapes while preserving generic parameters. Polymorphic this and local typeof dependencies are excluded.
Only lexically resolved local subjects and primitive literal equality cases qualify; getters, enum/named constants, RegExp values and unresolved globals are excluded.

Only direct literal equality ladders on an unrebound parameter in its own function scope block, with a proven declared Python minimum of 3.10. Captured/class selectors, attributes, grouped membership, guards and unknown targets remain advisory.
Only invariant actual bool/None values across at least two closed direct callers block, without parameter rebinding or namespace access. Other literals and callable default capture remain advisory.
A public error can carry dynamic context such as missing paths. Names and error suffixes do not prove a finite reason-code domain.
copy.replace invokes __replace__ and dataclasses.replace invokes __post_init__; deleting discarded calls can remove effects.
Canonical JsonValue rejects inputs that a recursive local alias can coerce, including Decimal and tuples; replacement can change accepted data.
Cancellation translation and task ownership can be deliberate; exception syntax alone does not prove that propagation is required.
Custom instance checks, imported exception classes and guard overlap can change refined matching; preserve the advisory contract.
A Node replacement requires runtime availability, encoding and closed provider proof; current warning scope does not establish these.
Equal values do not imply equal schema transformations, independent domains or identity. ZodUnion and multi-value literal introspection/error contracts differ.
Whole-object reads can invoke extra getters or Proxy traps; partial and prefix assertions can deliberately observe fewer fields.

severitySemantics: The eight bounded Python rules preserve native WARNING for unsupported compatibility cases. The Standards catalog/preset enables the rule at ERROR without converting those native warnings; CLI warning-only findings exit zero and stay out of blocking baselines.
scopeRepairs: Preserve Final mutable-container APIs and unwrap canonical Annotated[Final[...], metadata].
Preserve explicit named open record aliases and schema aliases rather than force runtime model conversions.
Prove effective method, constructor and validator bindings; skip overwritten and nested lexical owners.
Inventory escaped canonical providers, namespace/frame access and owned class values, including parent imported namespaces.
Track all owned TypeScript program modules; skip effectful static blocks, prototype mutation and constructor hooks.
Invalidate Python constructor origins after opaque value escapes, receiver calls and TypeGuard adaptation.
Require literal-dispatch parameter ownership in the same function, and actual singleton values across all known test-factory calls.
Preserve imported-model indexes when adding synthetic standalone class units.
Keep patched or escaped classes advisory for Self; require an intact builtin descriptor provider for Pydantic validators.
Split provenance, descriptor, class-origin and clock checks into coherent helpers that meet the repository complexity limit.
Inspect all runtime owned class references with explicit annotation/base/direct-constructor exclusions, retaining captured defaults, operators, iteration and yielded aliases.
Require inert class member values and closed canonical Field/ConfigDict; apply descriptor alias precision to existing SARJ491–493.
Resolve escaped TypeScript namespace exports, bracket members and implicit namespace method receivers.
Reject self-imported private function member aliases throughout known-caller proof.
Retain imports-only sibling modules and canonical named, module, wildcard and cyclic reexports in owned class escape proofs.
Bound each canonical origin query to 4,096 traversal states; exhaustion treats every owned class as escaped and preserves advisory or abstaining behavior.
Use a named immutable validator ownership record and cohesive TypeScript nominal-contract helpers.
Treat base/annotation call arguments and unknown generic subscription values as runtime escapes; only source-proven generic providers retain type exclusions.
Invalidate generic provider proof for wildcard replacement, direct/member/namespace mutation, first-class escapes and nested import aliases across the owned project.
Resolve named and qualified re-exported generic provider namespaces across owned units; normalize single-part namespace origins and conservatively handle incomplete closure.
